propositions: The close gate does not name the `duplicates` link as a remedy when a `--class duplicate` close fails due to missing replacement link, leaving operators with only impossible fallthrough paths (complete unfinished work or attest falsely).

A `--class duplicate` close with no recorded `duplicates` link should hard-fail with a deterministic error message naming the exact `rebar link <id> <canonical> duplicates` command, before any LLM billable call.
The hard-fail gate must accept a `duplicates` link whose target is closed (link existence only; target openness is not required).
The gate must distinguish between a `duplicates` link naming an archived/unresolvable target and having no link recorded at all, with distinct error messages for each.
Scoped hard-fail applies to `--class duplicate` only; `not_a_bug`, `escalated`, and non-disposition close classes retain the prior fallthrough behavior unchanged.
